comment: detect.c furniture_detect() remembered-furniture arm (1107-1112). A debug Wizard on Dlvl 1 of seed 8812004 creates eight small mimics around her; set_mimic_sym() gives one of them a throne disguise (M_AP_FURNITURE), which display_monster() also writes into map memory. She maps the level, teleports onto the down stairs in another room, wishes for a blessed crystal ball and looks for '\': furniture_detect() finds the remembered throne glyph on floor terrain, reveals the mimic with seemimic(), and, since the mimic is out of her sight, marks the spot with map_invisible().
